title: Johannes Serranus' Dictionarium Latinogermanicum (Nuremberg, 1538)
institution: Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel (Editiones Electronicae Guelferbytanae 16); transcribed by Jonathan West
author: Johannes Serranus
notes: Transcription of the 428-page Latin-German dictionary printed by Johann Petreius in Nuremberg in 1538 (copy: HAB, P 1084.8° Helmst.), in 23 TEI files (front matter, letters A-Z, back matter) linked to the facsimile. Counts are ours: about 114,000 words counted over the 23 TEI part files (tags removed; headwords included). Published in 2015; no later change was found.
